description: This file defines the AttributeBag class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Core DTO (Data Transfer Object) namespace. The class provides an encapsulated collection for managing key-value attribute pairs, supporting operations such as adding, replacing, removing, and retrieving parameters, and implements iterator and countable interfaces for iterable features.

classes.name: AttributeBag
classes.description: A class implementing a collection of attributes as key-value pairs, enabling standard collection operations, iteration, and counting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AttributeBag with an optional array of parameters.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all parameters as an array.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns all keys of the stored parameters.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces the entire parameter collection with a new array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merges provided parameters into the existing collection.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, returning default if key does not exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Assigns a value to a specific key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the collection.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated value from the collection.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the parameters.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of parameters stored.
